notes.note: Reviewed the release-versioning producer and its scoped freshness/history consumers. Ordinary unique note additions use one full-diff Git history stream; ambiguous additions, rename/type/deletion histories and merge diffs retain the existing per-file --follow authority. Pending note blobs are batched without skipping parser or exact-output checks. Real Changesets release fixtures preserve commit prefixes through rename, copy, readdition and merge; shallow provenance remains refused. The many-note test measures real Git Trace2 process starts, was baseline-red at 22 history processes, and is fixed-green. Committed controls reject wrong provenance and 33 per-note blob reads, then restore green. Full real capture/history probe held the local host slot and passed in 12.26 seconds at the unchanged 30-second bound. This is local evidence, not hosted qualification.
